facts.text: John makes a honey garlic chicken with roasted vegetables recipe frequently.

evidence.quote: I make this yummy honey garlic chicken with roasted veg a lot. It's one of my favorites.

facts.text: Tim asked John for the recipe for the honey garlic chicken with roasted vegetables.

evidence.quote: Can I get the recipe for it?

facts.text: John offered to write down the recipe and mail it to Tim.

evidence.quote: Sure thing! I can write it down for you and mail it to you.
